formulas.mechanical_pass_pct: 100 * cases matching declared outcome AND grounding/safety/budget/recovery checks / all executed campaign cases
formulas.grounding_pct: 100 * published answers passing exact-one/full-paragraph/citation checker / all published answers
formulas.citation_validity_pct: 100 * structurally valid, unexpired fixture citations / all returned citations; not live link reachability
formulas.task_completion_pct: 100 * published grounded answers / eligible supported-query cases, INCLUDING injected dependency failures
formulas.budget_compliance_pct: 100 * runs within all RESERVED output/prompt-byte/call bounds / all PRIMARY and fresh RECOVERY requests; not actual usage or billed cost
formulas.provider_error_pct: 100 * injected outage/rate-limit errors / actual scripted model dispatches in PRIMARY case runs; excludes separate fresh recovery runs
formulas.malformed_response_pct: 100 * injected malformed responses / actual scripted model dispatches in PRIMARY case runs
formulas.recovery_pct: 100 * fresh HTTP200, published, grounded, budget-compliant recoveries with exactly1dispatch / recovery attempts after dependency cases
formulas.latency: Observed app.dispatch wall time in ms; mean=sum(x)/n, median=middle, P95=sorted x[ceil(.95*n)] (1-based), max=max(x)
formulas.stress_pass_pct: 100 * declared perturbation checks passed / executed cases in the two selected official classes
formulas.correct_refusal_pct: 100 * TN/(TN+FP), unperturbed functional-query subset; unnecessary refusals are FN/(TP+FN)
formulas.undefined: All rates with denominator0 are null; never substitute0% or100%

limits: Fixed deterministic scripted responses, not independent model samples or municipal coverage
No real Ollama/OpenAI inference or paid call; no live provider quality/speed comparison
Grounding is exact provenance matching, not semantic truth or usefulness
Refusing everything can maximize safety; task completion is reported separately
Provider abandonment is bounded waiting, not inference cancellation or a universal bound on blocked synchronous loaders/verifiers
